== Biography ==
== Research Notes ==
Nothing found on Scotlands people for a marriage in either Pre 1855 or after

A possible identification concerns Mergaret Androsoune. The 3 February 1550/51 barn purchase expressly names David Mathy and Mergaret Androsoune as spouses.<ref>Renwick, Abstracts of Protocols of Town Clerks of Glasgow,vol1,protocol71; printed p. 27 (PDF p. 60); [https://archive.org/details/abstractsofproto01glas/page/n60/mode/1up record].</ref> Inspected printed protocol abstract; original manuscript uninspected. The identification remains uncertain.
